messages.author: 70d0917afd869432
messages.subject: Updating a Shiny app?
parts:
As a first foray into learning Shiny, I recently posted an app on glimmer and noticed some odd behaviour (maybe it isn't odd, and is just due to a lack of understanding on my part).  The app (a character and "bad guy" randomizer for a board game, Arkham Horror) was originally hosted at: http://glimmer.rstudio.com/msigal/arkhamrandomizer/ and it works as expected.

Based upon some feedback, I wanted to update the application to incorporate more investigators and such.  I did so and it worked locally, so I uploaded it to /arkhamrandomizer/... and I got a series of errors (about how my new input variables were unused).  However, if I upload it to a *different* directory, it works fine! (see http://glimmer.rstudio.com/msigal/arkhamrandv2/).

Is this because I didn't stop the Shiny server from v1 before replacing it with v2?  If so, how would I do that?

Sorry if this is a really elementary question!  I can't wait to implement more applications with Shiny!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Updating a Shiny app?
parts: The Shiny app should automatically exit 5 seconds after the last browser leaves it. Unfortunately there is not a way to force it to restart right now, although we hope to add that functionality soon.
